character_data.title: 鹿皮棉质防风帽
character_data.text:
陈旧的鹿皮棉质防风帽，受访者表示这顶帽子是她祖父的旧物。
由于原本的帽型过大，受访者将其改造，破损处已被细心地缝好，突出的两截尖角也是改造后的证明。

character_data.title: “包裹满当当”
character_data.text:
常规的露营行囊无法装下这么多东西，该行囊已进行过多次改良，足够容纳求生所需。
内嵌多层暗格，受访者不吝打开包裹向我们展现她的所有巧思。于是，巧克力糖纸、半截蜡烛、一把塞内草等各式零碎物件于不同的犄角旮旯处被发现。

character_data.title: “从未折过”
character_data.text:
尖锐的鹤嘴、刚硬的斧身，是辅助攀登冰地雪坡的重要工具。
“从未折过。”受访者表示。仿佛她在谈论的不仅仅是一柄冰镐。

character_data.title: 去南方，去那无人的地方！
character_data.text:
二十世纪初叶，第二次工业革命后的美丽年代。人们有了电，有了飞跃的科技，有了完整的学科体系，也再次有了“把世界翻过来看看”的热情。

1909年，美国探险家乘船划破了北极点的海面，给踌躇不定的人们抽上了狠狠一鞭子：快出发，梦想家们，去征服最后的秘境吧！去把每一寸雪都挖开，在侏罗纪的岩石上刻下自己的名字！

从乌斯怀亚，从悉尼，从威尔士，从卑尔根，一支支队伍竞赛般驶向最后一片未被人类完全丈量过的大陆。
前仆后继，餐风饮雪，人们在南极点插上了旗帜，绘出了全境地图，用命名宣誓了人类文明对化外之地的主权。

最后，他们站在世界的尽头大声喊：“我们已经解开了一切谜题！”

祝你旅途顺利，我们的小诺谛卡。

character_data.title: “地母”
character_data.text:
白雪松：好吧，那么我们先来聊聊“地母”。既然你坚持“地母”传说是你生命中不可或缺的一部分。
诺谛卡：太感谢你了，白雪松女士！希望《UTTU》杂志能让更多人知晓我们的文化，感受蕴含在神话中的魅力。
白雪松：“地母”——流传在你故乡神话中的唯一神明，她是个什么样子的？
诺谛卡：巨大的白色驼鹿是她的使者，而她为我们留住了光，编织了极昼。
白雪松：所以，她看上去像一只白色驼鹿。
诺谛卡：唔……也不是。关于地母的样子，我小时候和爷爷聊过。
诺谛卡：在爷爷的想象中，她是一株投下的阳光巨木，也许是挪威槭！
白雪松：无固定形态，任人书写的传说……
诺谛卡：不是哦！地母或许没有一个广受肯定的形象，但她的故事、她留下的箴言是固定的，她给予我们的指引也是坚实而肯定的！
诺谛卡：你也想象一下吧，白雪松女士！一个温暖的、能永远给你指引的地母……在你心中是什么样的？
白雪松：噢，这倒是新鲜……或许是乘着风和蛛丝飘荡的……

character_data.title: 金鸟头冠
character_data.text:
以飞鸟振翅为设计灵感的头冠，纪念神鸟迎来新生的瞬间。
据说，当这顶冠冕被重新戴上时，众鸟将纷纷飞临，并献上最美的羽毛作为朝贺。

character_data.title: 燃烧的火羽
character_data.text:
最贴近胸口的一簇羽毛，寄托着受访者心中的热望。
无论多少次燃烧殆尽、再从火中复生，只要信念未曾动摇，这簇鲜红就永不熄灭。

character_data.title: “淬炼”
character_data.text:
一串金质链饰，使用传统的冲压与浮雕工艺制成，妥帖地环绕在受访者的腰间。
只有纯净的黄金才能在经受火的考验后更加光辉灿烂，正如灵魂踏入死地后方能彰显它的光彩。

character_voice.name: 主页交互1
character_voice.content: 每一趟探究的旅程都充满荆棘，我必须比想象中更坚定，更无畏……#0|揭秘之心一直促使我在黑暗之中向前，#7|但有时候谜底过于沉重，也让我踌躇，犹豫着要不要揭开它的面纱。#11

So, with each step, I urge myself to grow stronger, braver, even more determined … #0|In the dark—in the unknown—curiosity is the light that guides me. #12|Even so, there have been moments where I hesitated, where I thought the cost might be too high.#18.9

character_voice.name: 主页交互2
character_voice.content: 一块闪光的石头……我永远无法忘记第一次看见它时的场景。#0|一切的奥秘都隐藏在其中，使它散发出如此瑰丽的光彩，#6.8|我们代代跋涉在荒原之中，只为目睹一场自然的奇迹，#12.6|它的启示让我几乎忘却了所有的痛苦。#17.9|因此……我会永远向前。#22.2
character_voice.encontent: There it was. A shiny, mysterious stone. I'll never forget the moment I first saw it. #0|So much was hidden inside that little piece of rock. #8.7|It glowed, calling me to that polar desert, just as it had called my family for generations. #13.2|And, somehow, it eased my pain. #21.4|That's why I'll never give up. Why I'll never stop moving forward.#25.6

character_voice.name: 初遇
character_voice.content: 又一次穿越死亡的林荫后，火焰为我塑造了新的形体。#0|如果你想问，我是否还是原来的我——请试试触碰这颗炽热的心吧。#4.9
character_voice.encontent: Once again, I've braved the darkness of death, this time fire remaking my flesh.#0|If you're wondering if I'm still me, please, touch my heart—the burning heat will speak for itself.#7.5

character_voice.name: 箱中气候
character_voice.content: 我们曾挤在船舱里，一个挨着一个，只为了躲避突如其来的风雪，#0|真希望那时的我也拥有这些小小的火苗。#6.7|不过，我们心中的确拥有火焰——另一种火焰。#10.7
character_voice.encontent: There were days when we'd all squeeze into the cabin to shelter from a sudden snowstorm.#0|If only I'd had these flames with me back then ... #6.5|But, if I think about it, I guess in some way we did—another kind of flame burning warm in our hearts.#10.6

character_voice.name: 致未来
character_voice.content: 有人说，时间是一个周而复始的圆，就像四季的轮替、不死鸟的复生……#0|有朝一日，我会变回那个不知所措的小女孩吗？#7.7
character_voice.encontent: Some say time is a loop, like the turning of the seasons or the rebirth of a phoenix ...#0|Does that mean one day, I'll go back to being that lost little girl again?#9

character_voice.name: 孑立
character_voice.content: 多么可爱的火焰，如同轻柔的风，它只会涤去攀附的尘埃，而不会伤害存在的本质……#0|噢！但对于箱子而言，还是有些危险的。#7.9
character_voice.encontent: What a very lovely little flame. Gentle as a breeze, only brushing off the dust without harming the essence of one's being ...#0|Oh! Right, but we should still be careful in here—the Suitcase won't handle it so well.#9.7

character_voice.name: 问候
character_voice.content: 维尔汀，能帮我梳理一下背上的羽毛吗？#0|请你沿着这里爬上来，对，这样我就能用尾巴托住你……#2.8
character_voice.encontent: Vertin, could you help me brush the feathers on my back?#0|You can climb here, like this. That way I can support you with my tail ...#4.6

character_voice.name: 朝晨
character_voice.content: 不知不觉中，我开始听得懂鸟儿们清晨的鸣唱，也看得懂云迹勾勒的故事了。#0|就像是世界深层的秘密逐渐敞开——我喜欢这份馈赠。#6.7
character_voice.encontent: Before I realized it, the songs in the dawn chorus took on new meaning, and the clouds in the sky carried all kinds of stories.#0|It's like ... the world's decided to reveal its secrets to me. Hm ... This is a true gift.#10.9

character_voice.name: 信任-朝晨
character_voice.content: 这些鸟儿很乐意来找我。它们似乎将我当成了同类，为我带来野花、果子或是羽毛……#0|来，也给你一片。#6.7
character_voice.encontent: These birds seem to have taken me as one of their kind. They visit me all the time, bringing flowers, fruits, or feathers ...#0|Here, Vertin, this one's for you.#9.9

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: 极地的夜晚，是比火焰更残酷的考验。#0|我见过许多难以焚毁的金属，在寒夜中却如玻璃般脆弱……#3.6
character_voice.encontent: Polar nights are more brutal than any fire.#0|I've seen metals that could survive a volcanic eruption turn as fragile as glass in that cold ...#4

character_voice.name: 信任-夜暮
character_voice.content: 看，我采集了一些乳香、檀木和月桂枝……不不不，你在想什么？#0|这只是几位研究员拜托我收集的实验材料，#6.1|我没有打算在今晚涅槃重生！#9
character_voice.encontent: Look, I've got some frankincense, sandalwood, and bay leaves ... What? No, no, no!#0|These are just experimental materials some researchers asked me to get. #7.5|Trust me, I have no intention of going through another rebirth tonight!#12.1

character_voice.name: 帽檐与发鬓
character_voice.content: 每一粒尘埃都是我的余烬，看，它们并未被抛却，就像过往始终是自我的一部分。#0
character_voice.encontent: Every one of these particles is part of the ashes I was born from. They stay close, see? Like how the past is always part of who we are now.#0

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: 那只擦拭过罗盘、紧握过冰镐的手已经殒灭了，#0|但我们在营火旁相拥的回忆却从未消失，#3.9|就像这十指仍有温度，仍能紧紧相扣——#7.4|幸好它们没变成羽翼，否则用翅膀吃饭可是个大难题！#11
character_voice.encontent: My old flesh is gone, along with those calloused hands that once held an ice axe,#0|but the memories never fade. The warmth of the campfire we used to snuggle next to still radiates within me, #6.8|like the warmth I can now feel on my new fingers. #15.9|Honestly, I'm just thankful I still have fingers—could you imagine using a knife and fork with wings?#20.7

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 如果我真的能借由这双翅膀飞向时间的尽头，在那儿，我会重新遇见祖父，还有大家吗？#0
character_voice.encontent: If these wings could fly me to the end of time, would Áddjá and all the others be there, waiting?#0

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 我们曾踏过许多人迹罕至之地，那里的深沉和寂静总是令人着迷。#0|苔原空旷、岩层冰冷，但它们从不是荒芜。它们是大地沉默的书写。#5.7
character_voice.encontent: We've been to many untrodden places, where the profound stillness and silence hold a fascinating allure.#0|The vast and empty tundra, the cold rock layers ... neither of them are barren. No, they are the speechless creations of the Earth.#8.2

character_voice.name: 赞赏
character_voice.content: “时间”本身就像一只不死的鸟儿，不断改变着，延续下去。#0|但你却能越过这周而复始的回环，触摸它的本质……维尔汀，你比一些神话传说更加独特。#5.1
character_voice.encontent: Time is like an immortal bird itself—ever-changing, ever-enduring.#0|But you can act outside that cycle, even touch its essence ... Vertin, you are more unique than any myth or legend.#6.2

character_voice.name: 亲昵
character_voice.content: 也许有一天，我还会消失在风雪中。维尔汀，你会等我吗？#0|我想我会尽力回来的，或许还会以另一种姿态，但我……仍会归来。#5.2
character_voice.encontent: If, and I mean if, one day I disappear into a blizzard again, would you wait for me, Vertin?#0|I'd do anything to return, I think—maybe even in a different form, but ... no matter what, I would find my way back.#9.3

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 最近，我得到了一些新的手稿。#0|东方藏经阁中未解明的语言，砾岩山崖下坍塌的墓穴，#2.5|干涸的河床边营地的遗址……一定还有更多的启示在等待揭晓。#7.4
character_voice.encontent: I've found some fascinating ancient manuscripts recently.#0|Undeciphered languages from the Eastern Book Pavilion, collapsed tombs beneath the conglomerate cliffs, #4.1|campsite ruins found along a dried-up riverbed ... There must be more revelations waiting to be uncovered.#11.4

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 有时，我能听到一些遥远的祈祷声。#0|仿佛有人追寻着我的存在而来，就像我追寻地母一样……#2.8|到那时，我该对他们说什么呢？也许一个无言的拥抱会更好？#8.4
character_voice.encontent: Maybe I'm just hearing things, but sometimes I think I hear people's prayers from afar.#0|It's as if ... someone's chasing after me, like I chased after the Mother Spirit ... #8.1|But, if they ever do find me, what should I say? Or maybe just a hug is enough?#15.9

character_voice.name: 独白
character_voice.content: 抛去旧的自我、重新诞生是一种很可怕的感受，#0|但若是再选一次，无论是冰冷的黑暗还是逼人的烈火，我仍会踏入其中。#4.4
character_voice.encontent: Shedding my old self and being reborn was ... horrifying.#0|But if I had to choose again, I'd make the same decision—whether an icy darkness or a raging fire, I would step into it.#6.2

character_voice.name: 入队
character_voice.content: 一次新的探险？#0
character_voice.encontent: A new adventure?#0

character_voice.name: 战前
character_voice.content: 让我走在最前面吧。#0
character_voice.encontent: Let me take the lead.#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 牺牲是难免的。#0
character_voice.encontent: Some sacrifices are inevitable.#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 听从这颗心。#0
character_voice.encontent: Follow your heart.#0

character_voice.name: 择选高阶咒语
character_voice.content: 哪怕不复存在。#0
character_voice.encontent: At the cost of burning out.#0

character_voice.name: 择选至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 倘若我的心脏必须破碎……#0
character_voice.encontent: If this heart must be broken ...#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 比冰霜更锐利。#0
character_voice.encontent: Sharper than an icicle.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 比太阳更明亮。#0
character_voice.encontent: Brighter than the sun.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 我们将得庇佑。#0
character_voice.encontent: We will be blessed.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 我将照耀。#0
character_voice.encontent: I will shine.#0

character_voice.name: 召唤至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 不要为此挣扎……这是我们都要抵达的去处。#0
character_voice.encontent: There's no need to struggle ... This is somewhere we all must go.#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 不用退缩。#0
character_voice.encontent: Don't back down.#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 小心！#0
character_voice.encontent: Watch out!#0

character_voice.name: 战斗胜利
character_voice.content: 荣光，从往昔之中冉冉升起。#0
character_voice.encontent: From what was, dawns a new beginning.#0

character_voice.name: 洞悉
character_voice.content: 我感受到了……自我的又一次更替。它并非总是出现在生死一线之际，#0|也会发生在一场胜利、一种领悟之时。#6.4
character_voice.encontent: I can feel it ... Something's changed—something inside me. It happened before when I was on the brink of death.#0|But now, I've learned it can fall upon you like an epiphany in moments of triumph.#11

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: 最初，穿越死生的道路是冰冷、黏腻、湿滑的。但它现在已经充满光辉——#0|因为每一位阿蒙森、每一个探险家、每一颗好奇的心，总是与我同在。#8.1
character_voice.encontent: The path from death to life was cold and slimy at first. But now, it's radiant with fire—#0|because every Amundsen, everyone with the spirit of exploration, is always with me.#10.1

character_voice.name: 主页交互触发
character_voice.content: 这枚心脏来自古老的传说，它会为不同的灵魂燃起独一无二的火焰。#0|维尔汀，我很好奇属于你的火焰是什么样子，来，只要轻轻触碰就好。#6.2
character_voice.encontent: This heart is from an ancient legend: it burns a flame unique to the soul it senses.#0|Vertin, I'm curious to see what yours will look like. So ... could you give it a gentle touch?#7.5

character_voice.name: 交互成功
character_voice.content: 我看到了，你的火焰像是一只雨燕——#0|虽然纤细小巧，但划过雨幕时，能够将整片天空点燃……#3.8
character_voice.encontent: I see it ... Your flame soaring like a swift through the rain.#0|Slender and small as it may seem, it is capable of igniting the entire sky ...#5.6

character_voice.name: 未交互
character_voice.content: 我明白你的意思，维尔汀。那火焰的样子，其实你早已知晓。#0
character_voice.encontent: I understand. It's your soul, you already know what it looks like.#0

character_voice.name: 入场后半
character_voice.content: 假如传说不仅仅是传说，我便可以……无数次在此复生。#0
character_voice.encontent: If the legend is more than just a story, then I may ... rise anew from it, over and over again.#0

skin.skinDescription: 或许历经遗忘的苦旅，生命仍为我们留有馈赠。
skin.skinStory:
死亡将近。
赐予你没药，红棕色的礼物如此馨香，却又有苦与辛辣，如同复合的咏叹调；
赐予你芬芳的枝杈，筑出宝贵的死亡之巢；
赐予你黎明的光，重生的歌谣因此而传唱。
铜香炉中，烈焰越发炙热，它燃烧着，耀眼得就像一颗正在重铸的心——世界上不会再有东西比它更亮了。环绕在侧的诗人、神祇与贤者皆发出了尖叫声，就连他们也无法忍受如此纯净的生命之焰。
终于，火焰熄灭了，没有人敢靠近它。她从半熄的灰烬中展开雪白的双翅，飞向了太阳诞生的城邦。
那是一切火的源头，所有眼睛最初的光，以及漫长黑暗里再次重燃的希望。即使这是宝贵的重生，即使无限贴近光明必然带来毁灭，但目标就在那里，未来就在那里。她决定再一次前行，毫不犹豫地飞向未知。

1281011.content: 板块与板块断裂又重新拼合，陆地上迅速生长出林木与山峰，无垠水面上的盘古大陆。
或许这里也是一处奇异的遗迹，某种古老的秘密……
是的、是的，我们还没找到通往谜底的那扇门。
有的秘密几年便会显露，有的则隐藏数百年……
（她开始四处打量，在周围走来走去）
谢谢——谢谢你的信任，虽然由于缺乏文献或手稿，我对于从何处着手还没任何头绪……
但我们可以先从观察开始？嗯……

1281012.content: 以前我总是很喜欢听睡前故事，关于地母的眷顾，孩童的旅行……父亲的父亲讲给他，他又讲给我。
我不知道把故事变成真正的冒险是好是坏，我只是忍不住去亲眼看看……
维尔汀，如果是你，你会怎么做？
你说得对……我的同伴们在雪中向我招手，有时候我还能听到来自他们的声音……
我并不想也不会忘记这些了，它们——是我的故事。
对吧？总得有个答案，即使它和我最初期待的不一样——
即使有一部分的我好像永远丢失在过去了。
